# LLM Configuration File for Eric Cao's Personal Website

This file provides metadata about the structure and content of this website to help large language models (LLMs) understand and navigate it effectively.

## Website Overview

- **Name**: Eric Cao's Personal Website
- **Purpose**: Personal portfolio and technical blog
- **Author**: Eric Cao (caoergou)
- **Domain**: https://eric.run.place
- **Languages**: Simplified Chinese (primary, at `/`), English (at `/en/`)
- **Category**: Personal Portfolio / Technology Blog

## Author Information

- **Name**: Eric Cao
- **GitHub**: @caoergou
- **Location**: Shanghai, China
- **Role**: Big Data & Full-Stack Engineer · Open Source Contributor
- **Focus Areas**: Practical AI adoption, AI Agent workflows, LLM apps, Big Data, Data Engineering, Python, Open Source

## Featured Projects

1. **airflow-extended-api-plugin** (~77 stars)
   - Airflow plugin wrapping RESTful APIs via CLI commands, supports Airflow v2.X
   - GitHub: https://github.com/caoergou/airflow-extended-api-plugin

2. **cnpip** (~61 stars)
   - One-click speed test and switch for pip & uv mirrors
   - GitHub: https://github.com/caoergou/cnpip

3. **MermZen** (~13 stars)
   - Minimalist Mermaid diagram editor, no login required, real-time preview, PNG/SVG export
   - GitHub: https://github.com/caoergou/MermZen
   - Demo: https://eric.run.place/MermZen/

## Site Structure

```
/                       # Home — Chinese (hero, about, experience, projects, thoughts, blog)
/en/                    # Home — English (server-rendered, distinct URL)
/blog                   # Blog post list
/blog/zh/[slug]/        # Individual blog post (Chinese, author-written)
/blog/en/[slug]/        # Individual blog post (English, auto-translated)
/llms.txt               # This file
/sitemap-index.xml      # Sitemap index
/rss.xml                # RSS feed
```

## Content Collections

- **profile**: Personal info, social links
- **projects**: Showcase projects with descriptions and star counts
- **thoughts**: Homepage topic cards (bilingual: zh + en)
- **posts/zh**: Blog articles (Chinese source, written by author)
- **posts/en**: Blog articles (English, auto-translated by Lingo.dev)

## Technology Stack

- **Static Site Generator**: Astro 6.x
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript
- **Internationalization**: URL-based (zh at `/`, en at `/en/`); blog English translated via Lingo.dev on push
- **Deployment**: GitHub Actions → GitHub Pages

## Visual Design

- **Theme**: Minimalist dark, inspired by Brittany Chiang
- **Background**: navy #0a192f
- **Accent**: green #64ffda
- **Text Primary**: #ccd6f6 (lightest slate)
- **Display Font**: Fraunces (serif)
- **Body Font**: Newsreader (serif)
- **Mono Font**: JetBrains Mono
